title: Bo'lajak o'qituvchining sun'iy intellektga oid kasbiy kompetensiyasi — o'z-o'zini baholash varaqasi
basis: Dissertatsiya 2.3-bo'lim (4 tarkibiy qism, 3 daraja) va UNESCO AI Competency Framework for Teachers (2024): 5 o'lchov, 15 kompetensiya, 3 daraja (acquire / deepen / create).

cognitive.name: Kognitiv
cognitive.desc: Texnologiyaning ishlash tamoyili, imkoniyati va cheklovlari haqidagi funksional bilim
cognitive.indicator: Tizim javobining kelib chiqishini izohlay olish
cognitive.unesco: AI foundations and applications; Human-centred mindset

didactic.name: Didaktik-texnologik
didactic.desc: Vositani o'quv maqsadiga bog'lash, mashg'ulotni loyihalash, ko'makni boshqarish
didactic.indicator: Texnologik vositali dars loyihasini mustaqil tuza olish

ethical.name: Axloqiy-mas'uliyatli
ethical.desc: Mualliflik, ma'lumotlar himoyasi, baholash adolatliligi va akademik halollik
ethical.indicator: Guruh uchun foydalanish qoidalarini ishlab chiqa olish

reflective.name: Refleksiv
reflective.desc: O'z tajribasini tahlil qilish, yechim samarasini baholash, undan voz kecha olish
reflective.indicator: Mashg'ulot natijasi asosida yondashuvni o'zgartira olish

levels.name: Boshlang'ich (acquire)
levels.desc: Vositalardan tayyor ko'rinishda foydalanadi, tanlov mezoni shakllanmagan
levels.criterion: Vositani nima uchun tanlaganini asoslay olishi

levels.name: Amaliy (deepen)
levels.desc: Vositani maqsadga muvofiq tanlaydi, mashg'ulotni loyihalaydi va natijani tahlil qiladi
levels.criterion: Mashg'ulot natijasiga qarab yechimni o'zgartira olishi

levels.name: Ijodiy (create)
levels.desc: O'z metodik yechimini ishlab chiqadi va hamkasblariga uzatadi
levels.criterion: Metodik ishlanmasini asoslab taqdim eta olishi

items.prompt_uz: Katta til modellari (masalan, ChatGPT, DeepSeek) matnni qanday hosil qilishini va nega ba'zan asossiz ma'lumot berishini tushuntira olaman.
items.prompt_en: I can explain how large language models generate text and why they sometimes produce unfounded information.

items.prompt_uz: AI vositasining javobi qaysi ma'lumotga tayanganini va qanday cheklovlari borligini talabaga tushuntira olaman.
items.prompt_en: I can explain to students what an AI tool's answer is based on and what its limitations are.

items.prompt_uz: Avtomatlashtirilgan baholash (AWE) vositalari grammatika va leksikani qanday aniqlashini va qayerda xato qilishini bilaman.
items.prompt_en: I know how automated writing evaluation tools detect grammar and lexis and where they fail.

items.prompt_uz: Adaptiv platforma talabaga nega aynan shu topshiriqni taklif qilganini (profil, daraja) o'qiy olaman.
items.prompt_en: I can read why an adaptive platform recommended a particular task (profile, level).

items.prompt_uz: Dars loyihasida AI vositasini aniq o'quv maqsadiga bog'lab, uni mashg'ulotning muayyan bosqichida qo'llayman.
items.prompt_en: In my lesson plan I link the AI tool to a specific learning objective and use it only at a specific stage.

items.prompt_uz: Mustaqil bajarish bosqichida texnologiyadan foydalanishni cheklab, ko'makni bosqichma-bosqich kamaytirishni rejalashtiraman.
items.prompt_en: I restrict technology use at the independent production stage and plan to reduce support step by step.

items.prompt_uz: Bir mashg'ulotda ikkitadan ortiq yangi vosita qo'llamayman va har biri uchun texnologiyasiz muqobil variant tayyorlayman.
items.prompt_en: I use no more than two new tools per lesson and prepare a non-technology alternative for each.

items.prompt_uz: AI izohini Hattie & Timperley bo'yicha vazifa darajasidan jarayon va o'zini boshqarish darajasiga ko'tarib bera olaman.
items.prompt_en: I can raise AI feedback from task level to process and self-regulation levels (Hattie & Timperley).

items.prompt_uz: Talabalar uchun AI dan foydalanish va akademik halollik qoidalarini (nima mumkin, nima oshkor qilinadi) yozma shaklda belgilay olaman.
items.prompt_en: I can set written rules for students on AI use and academic integrity (what is allowed, what must be disclosed).

items.prompt_uz: Talabalar ma'lumotlarini (matnlar, baholar, ovoz yozuvlari) qayerda saqlanishi va kim ko'rishini bilaman hamda minimal hajmda yig'aman.
items.prompt_en: I know where student data (texts, grades, recordings) is stored and who sees it, and I collect the minimum.

items.prompt_uz: AI hosil qilgan materialni talabalarga aniq belgilab (manbasini ko'rsatib) taqdim etaman.
items.prompt_en: I present AI-generated material to students clearly labelled, with its source shown.

items.prompt_uz: Baholashni mahsulotdan jarayonga ko'chirib, texnologiyasiz nazorat shakllarini saqlab qolaman.
items.prompt_en: I shift assessment from product to process and keep technology-free forms of control.

items.prompt_uz: Mashg'ulotdan so'ng AI vositasi qaysi talabalarga foyda bergani va kimga xalaqit berganini tahlil qilaman.
items.prompt_en: After a lesson I analyse which students the AI tool helped and whom it hindered.

items.prompt_uz: Natija kutilganidek bo'lmasa, vositadan voz kechib yoki o'rnini almashtirib yondashuvni o'zgartiraman.
items.prompt_en: If results fall short, I change the approach, dropping or replacing the tool.

items.prompt_uz: O'z texnologik vositali darsimni refleksiv hisobot shaklida yozib, hamkasblar bilan muhokama qilaman.
items.prompt_en: I write a reflective report on my technology-mediated lesson and discuss it with colleagues.

items.prompt_uz: Vositani tanlash sababimni metodik jihatdan asoslab, ishlanmamni hamkasblarga taqdim eta olaman.
items.prompt_en: I can justify my choice of tool methodologically and present my lesson design to colleagues.

pathways.path: O'quv jarayoni: metodika fanlariga integratsiya va alohida modul; kafedra metodik ishi (ochiq dars, tajriba almashinuvi)
Pedagogik amaliyot: texnologik vositali darsni loyihalash va o'tkazish; mikroo'qitish
Kafedra metodik ishi: foydalanish va akademik halollik qoidalarini ishlab chiqish
Mustaqil rivojlanish: refleksiv hisobot, o'z mashg'ulotini tahlil qilish; uzluksiz malaka oshirish

tool_evaluation_checklist.q: Vosita qaysi o'quv maqsadiga xizmat qiladi?
Qanday ma'lumot to'planadi va qayerda saqlanadi?
tool_evaluation_checklist.criterion: Maxfiylik siyosati ochiq e'lon qilingan bo'lishi

tool_evaluation_checklist.q: O'zbek tilidagi so'rovga to'g'ri javob beradimi?
tool_evaluation_checklist.criterion: Ona tili xatolarini to'g'ri talqin qilishi
Cheklangan tezlikda ishlashi yoki muqobili bo'lishi

tool_evaluation_checklist.q: O'qituvchi natijani ko'ra va o'zgartira oladimi?
